note: Glue submodule: a single hook_migrate_process_info_alter() that sets core migration_lookup's class to MigMagLookup (from migmag_process). No config/UI/permissions/Drush/plugins. Verified via the core process plugin manager (works on this site; the migration plugin manager is broken by pathauto but is not needed). Baseline: this module DISABLED (migration_lookup = core MigrationLookup). Introspection reads migration_lookup's class with the override on; execution toggles the override on (class -> MigMagLookup) and off (class -> core MigrationLookup).

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal module migmag_process_lookup_replace do, and which core migrate process plugin does it affect?
evals.expected_output: It implements hook_migrate_process_info_alter() to set core's migration_lookup process plugin class to Drupal\migmag_process\Plugin\migrate\process\MigMagLookup, so every migration using migration_lookup gets the improved lookup without editing YAML.

evals.prompt: Which module provides the MigMagLookup class that migmag_process_lookup_replace forces core's migration_lookup to use, i.e. what is its dependency?
evals.expected_output: migmag_process_lookup_replace depends on migmag_process, which provides the MigMagLookup class (the migmag_lookup process plugin).

evals.prompt: If I only want ONE specific migration to use Migrate Magician's improved lookup instead of overriding migration_lookup globally, what should I do instead of enabling migmag_process_lookup_replace?
evals.expected_output: Don't enable migmag_process_lookup_replace; instead set that migration's process step to 'plugin: migmag_lookup' directly. The lookup_replace module is only for a global override of core migration_lookup.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, migmag_process_lookup_replace has been enabled. Inspect the migrate process plugin manager and report the implementing class of the migration_lookup process plugin.

On this Drupal site the forced-lookup override is active. Inspecting the running site, which Migrate Magician module provides the class that migration_lookup now uses (i.e. what is enabled alongside it)?
evals.expected_output: migmag_process provides the MigMagLookup class; it is enabled as a dependency of migmag_process_lookup_replace (the enabled override module).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, force core's migration_lookup process plugin to use Migrate Magician's MigMagLookup implementation globally (no YAML edits). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable migmag_process_lookup_replace (drush en migmag_process_lookup_replace -y). migration_lookup's class becomes Drupal\migmag_process\Plugin\migrate\process\MigMagLookup.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the global forced-lookup override is currently active (migration_lookup uses MigMagLookup). Remove the override so that core's migration_lookup process plugin uses core's own MigrationLookup class again. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Uninstall migmag_process_lookup_replace (drush pmu migmag_process_lookup_replace -y). migration_lookup's class returns to Drupal\migrate\Plugin\migrate\process\MigrationLookup.
